question: Devprayag is situated at the confluence of rivers Alaknanda and

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Devprayag** is situated at the confluence of the **Alaknanda** and **Bhagirathi** rivers in Uttarakhand. It marks the point where these two rivers merge to form the holy **Ganga River**. Devprayag is one of the five sacred confluences, known as Panch Prayag, in Hindu tradition.
